The shop

Ten years in the trade, right on 410.

One long room off Highway 410: pedicure chairs down one wall, manicure tables down the other, and a wall of polish by the front door to pick from.

“We are a team of professional that work in this industry over ten years of experiences. We provides services pedicure & manicures shellac. We also expert of acrylic & dipping powder.”

Nails 410, in their own words

No appointment system, no membership, no upsell script — you come in, they find you a chair, and the work takes as long as the work takes. Customers keep saying the same two things about this place: they got seen right away, and nobody rushed them.

Come see them

Three steps, that's the whole thing.

  1. Walk in

    No booking, no deposit. If a chair is open, it's yours.

  2. Pick a color

    The polish wall is right inside the door. Bring a screenshot if you have one — they'll match it.

  3. Take your time

    Soak, shape, paint, dry. Nobody hurries you out.
